lines.japanese: まあ、ここは明日香さんとの約束を遵守するか。
lines.english: Well, I would honor my promise to Asuka.

lines.japanese: ただの買い物だし、俺と明日香さんだし、間違っても色気のある話になるわけがない。いらん気を回しすぎる方がおかしいだろう。それに──
lines.english: It was merely shopping, and it was Asuka and me. There was no conceivable way it could turn romantic. Overthinking it would be stranger. Besides—

lines.japanese: 「──本当は日和子さんにも来てもらいたいんすけど、バイトあるから無理っすよね」
lines.english: “—I'd honestly like you to come too, Hiyoko, but you have work, so you can't.”

lines.japanese: 「まあ、そうですね」
lines.english: “Yes, I suppose so.”

lines.japanese: 日和子さんは時計を見る仕草とともに、しれっと言いました。
lines.english: Hiyoko checked her watch and answered with studied indifference.

lines.japanese: 「そんな時間はありませんから遠慮させていただきます。どうぞおふたりで」
lines.english: “I have no time, so I must decline. Please enjoy yourselves.”

lines.japanese: 「すみません」
lines.english: “I'm sorry.”

lines.japanese: 「何がですか？　べつに謝ることはないでしょう」
lines.english: “For what? You have no reason to apologize.”
“Well...”

lines.japanese: そうですけど、かと言って、謝らないでへらへらしてるのも……
lines.english: That was true, but standing here grinning without apologizing would also be...

lines.japanese: 「ねえ？」
lines.english: “Right?”

lines.japanese: 「はあ。小首を傾げられても」
lines.english: “Tilting your head at me won't help.”

lines.japanese: 「悪いね玉泉、今回だけ。用が済んだらすぐ返すから」
lines.english: “Sorry, Tamaizumi. Just this once. I'll return him as soon as we're done.”

lines.japanese: 「べつに？　ゆっくりしてらしたらいいんじゃないですか」
lines.english: “I don't mind. Take all the time you like.”

lines.japanese: 「それじゃ失礼します」
lines.english: “Then excuse me.”

lines.japanese: ひとりで立ちさる日和子さん。このまま行かせたくはないけれど、かと言って引きとめる理由もありません。
lines.english: Hiyoko walked away alone. I did not want to let her go like this, but neither did I have a reason to stop her.

lines.japanese: 「あとでアレキサンダー行きますんで！」
lines.english: “I'll come to Alexander later!”

lines.japanese: 背中にそれだけ投じてみました。
lines.english: That was all I could throw after her.

lines.japanese: 彼女はほとんど振りかえりませんでしたが、ちょこっと会釈だけを残していきました。
lines.english: She barely looked back, leaving only the smallest bow.

lines.japanese: それを見送りながら明日香さん。
lines.english: Asuka watched her go.

lines.japanese: 「拗ねちゃった？」
lines.english: “Is she sulking?”

lines.japanese: 「や、うちの彼女、こんなんでグズるほど子供じゃないっすよ」
lines.english: “No. My girlfriend isn't childish enough to make a fuss over this.”

lines.japanese: 日和子さんの体裁を保つためにそんな返答をしておきましたが、実際のとこどうなんでしょう。微妙。
lines.english: I answered that way to preserve Hiyoko's dignity, but what was the truth? Hard to say.

lines.japanese: はあ、失敗したかな……。
lines.english: Sigh. Had I made a mistake...?

lines.japanese: 「こっちは落ちこんでる」
lines.english: “This one is depressed.”

lines.japanese: 「や、うちの彼氏、こんなんでヘコむほど子供じゃないっすよ」
lines.english: “No. Her boyfriend isn't childish enough to get crushed by this.”

lines.japanese: 嘘ですけどね。かなりデリケートな男の子ですよ、ぼく。
lines.english: That was a lie. I was a very sensitive boy.

lines.japanese: 「ごめん」
lines.english: “Sorry.”
“...What?”

lines.japanese: がっくり項垂れてたら、不意に明日香さんの申し開き。
lines.english: While I hung my head, Asuka unexpectedly explained herself.

lines.japanese: 「ホントのこと言うと、一度じっくり話がしたかったんです」
lines.english: “Truthfully, I wanted one chance to sit down and talk properly.”

lines.japanese: 「誰と？」
lines.english: “With who?”
“With...”

lines.japanese: フイッと顎で指された。意地でも「羽田君」以外の名前は口にしたくないってか。
lines.english: She jerked her chin toward me. Was she determined never to utter any name except Haneda?

lines.japanese: けど、まあ──
lines.english: But then—

lines.japanese: 「──そんなこっちゃないかとは思ってました」
lines.english: “—I figured it was something like that.”

lines.japanese: 鼻で笑ってやりましたよ。
lines.english: I gave her a snort.
